title: Understand attention
outcome: Build a small sequence model and an attention calculation for soccer events.

blocks.body: Question: Can the order of events help prediction?
Mathematics: Learn embeddings, softmax attention, positional information, and masking through matrix operations.
Dataset: StatsBomb events/{match_id}.json: ordered events within each match. Define the target at a fixed prediction time and exclude all later events.
Reading: D2L attention and transformer chapters. Full transformer training is a stretch goal, not a completion requirement.

blocks.title: Dive into Deep Learning
blocks.note: Use the interactive book for calculus, automatic differentiation, training loops, and attention.

blocks.body: Challenge: Explain how attention weights are calculated and show a future-information leak prevented by a mask.

tasks.prompt: Define a next-event task with information available at prediction time. Split by match and date.
